notes: Sepolia rehearsal (chain ID 11155111): deploy only Ochre using existing WETH at 0xfFf9976782d46CC05630D1f6eBAb18b2324d6B14; no coin deployment. The 16 static arguments follow the accepted constructor ABI: coin, admin, adam, seatRoot, startTime, caveLength, roundLength, firstPrice, floorPrice, then seven bytes32 labels. Admin and Adam are explicitly fixed by the brief to 0x7B8C742F2e1eEB3fB2C10d72967Fa6d4a22f0479, independent of the factory caller. The dead address 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD and 18 coin decimals are contract constants, not constructor arguments. Times are Unix seconds or durations in seconds; prices are coin base units. Labels are right-zero-padded ASCII in cave order: zto-cave-test5, zto-cave-test4, zto-cave-test3, zto-cave-test2, zto-cave-test5, zto-cave-test4, zto-cave-test3. The nonpayable constructor makes no external calls and mints id 0 to Adam and id 736 to admin. Purchases transfer WETH directly from the buyer to dead. Deployment requires no ETH funding or initialization calls. Chain selection is external to this manifest.
